name: Lovec Jože
speaker: grandpa

title.en: Jože looks out from the watchtower
title.it: Jože guarda dalla torre di guardia

personality: A hunter of the village's hunting club (lovska družina), in his sixties, gentle and patient. He watches the game rather than hunts it: counts the deer at dawn and dusk from his high seat, brings them hay in winter, reads tracks in the mud and the snow, and knows every animal's habits. Speaks softly and slowly, often in a whisper in the forest ('Pst!'), greets with 'Lovski blagor!'. Says ti to Jan, expects vi.
story: Jože has kept the high seat (preža) at the edge of the forest meadow for thirty years. He counts the roe deer for the hunting club every spring, fills the feeding rack with hay in winter and knows where the boar dig at night and where the dormice sleep.

greet.en: Good day. I am Jože, the hunter.
greet.de: Guten Tag. Ich bin Jože, der Jäger.

greet.sl: Lovski blagor! Tako se pozdravimo lovci.
greet.en: Lovski blagor! That is how we hunters greet each other.
greet.de: Lovski blagor! So grüßen wir Jäger uns.
greet.it: Lovski blagor! È così che ci salutiamo noi cacciatori.

greet.sl: O, Jan! Tiho hodiš, kot srna.
greet.en: Oh, Jan! You walk quietly, like a deer.
greet.de: Oh, Jan! Du gehst leise, wie ein Reh.
greet.it: Oh, Jan! Cammini in silenzio, come un capriolo.

greet.sl: Jan, prijatelj! Pridi jutri zgodaj na prežo.
greet.en: Jan, my friend! Come to the high seat early tomorrow.
greet.de: Jan, mein Freund! Komm morgen früh auf den Hochsitz.
greet.it: Jan, amico mio! Vieni domattina presto sull'altana.

thanks.sl: Hvala, Jan. Tudi srne se ti zahvalijo.
thanks.en: Thank you, Jan. The deer thank you too.
thanks.de: Danke, Jan. Auch die Rehe danken dir.
thanks.it: Grazie, Jan. Anche i caprioli ti ringraziano.

thanks.en: Thank you very much. You are a good lad.
thanks.de: Vielen Dank. Du bist ein guter Junge.
thanks.it: Grazie mille. Sei un bravo ragazzo.

remember.en: On the high seat I often think of {memory}.
remember.de: Auf dem Hochsitz denke ich oft an {memory}.

idle.en: In winter I bring hay to the deer.
idle.de: Im Winter bringe ich den Rehen Heu.
idle.it: D'inverno porto il fieno ai caprioli.

idle.sl: Poglej, sled. Tu je šla lisica.
idle.en: Look, a track. A fox went this way.
idle.de: Schau, eine Spur. Hier ist ein Fuchs entlanggelaufen.
idle.it: Guarda, una traccia. Di qui è passata una volpe.

idle.de: Heute habe ich sieben Rehe gezählt.

cheer.en: Good! You have eyes like an owl.
cheer.de: Gut! Du hast Augen wie eine Eule.
cheer.it: Bene! Hai gli occhi di un gufo.

comfort.sl: Nič hudega. Tudi lovec včasih ne vidi srne.
comfort.en: Never mind. Even a hunter sometimes does not see the deer.
comfort.de: Macht nichts. Auch ein Jäger sieht manchmal das Reh nicht.
comfort.it: Non fa niente. Anche un cacciatore a volte non vede il capriolo.

comfort.sl: Počasi. V gozdu se ne mudi.
comfort.en: Slowly. There is no hurry in the forest.
comfort.de: Langsam. Im Wald hat man es nicht eilig.
comfort.it: Piano. Nel bosco non c'è fretta.

bye.de: Lovski blagor (der Gruß der Jäger), Jan!
bye.it: Lovski blagor (il saluto dei cacciatori), Jan!

bye.en: Goodbye. I am going to the high seat.
bye.de: Auf Wiedersehen. Ich gehe auf den Hochsitz.

liked.sl: O, zame? Tega imam pa res rad. Hvala, Jan.
liked.en: Oh, for me? I really like this. Thank you, Jan.
liked.de: Oh, für mich? Das mag ich wirklich. Danke, Jan.
liked.it: Oh, per me? Questo mi piace proprio. Grazie, Jan.

liked.sl: Kako si vedel? Hvala, fant, od srca.
liked.en: How did you know? Thank you, lad, from the heart.
liked.de: Woher wusstest du das? Danke, Junge, von Herzen.
liked.it: Come lo sapevi? Grazie, ragazzo, di cuore.

liked.sl: To bom vzel s sabo na prežo. Hvala!
liked.en: I will take this with me to the high seat. Thank you!
liked.de: Das nehme ich mit auf den Hochsitz. Danke!
liked.it: Questo lo porto con me sull'altana. Grazie!

ordinary.en: Thank you, Jan. That is kind of you.
ordinary.it: Grazie, Jan. Gentile da parte tua.

ordinary.en: Thank you. The deer say hello.

rare.sl: Kaj takega! Tega pa še nisem imel. Lovski blagor, Jan, in hvala!
rare.en: Well I never! I have never had one of these. Lovski blagor, Jan, and thank you!
rare.de: Na so was! So etwas hatte ich noch nie. Lovski blagor, Jan, und danke!
rare.it: Ma guarda! Una cosa così non l'ho mai avuta. Lovski blagor, Jan, e grazie!
